name: Athens
tagline: Souvlaki like always in Monastiraki, and Greece's two highest Michelin stars.

Spondi.description: Refined Franco-Greek fusion in a serene courtyard. Two Michelin stars, the highest in Greece, reviewed by critic Andy Hayler.

O Thanasis.description: A souvlaki institution on Monastiraki Square, with tables outside and old-school prices.

Platanos.description: A taverna in Plaka open since 1932, with a history of famous visitors like Henry Miller. Classic Greek cooking.

Psarras.description: A Plaka institution since 1898, with terraces stepped between floors and grilled fish.

Krinos.description: A historic pastry shop on Aiolou Street, near Monastiraki, famous for its cream bougatsa.
